summary: Validated the new switchable storage abstraction layer (STORAGE_TYPE=emergent active). 14/14 pytest tests passed covering login for all 3 roles, deal creation, client/processor proof uploads via EmergentStorage, file download, deal detail with proofs, proof delete, and admin-only /api/storage/status (returns backend=emergent, class=EmergentStorage; 403 for trader/treasury). Frontend smoke test also passed: trader login → dashboard (Welcome toast), My Deals page loads with created test deal, New Deal nav button visible, zero console errors.
passed_tests: POST /api/auth/login — trader/treasury/admin all return 200 with token + correct role
POST /api/deals — trader creates deal, status=pending, reference_number generated
GET /api/deals — created deal appears in list
GET /api/deals/{id} — returns deal with settlement_proofs[] and history[]
POST /api/deals/{id}/upload?proof_type=client — PNG upload returns {id, path, filename, content_type, proof_type}; path is prefixed app-name/deals/{deal_id}/{uuid}.png
GET /api/deals/{id} after upload — settlement_proofs contains uploaded proof
Frontend: trader login redirects to /dashboard, Welcome back toast shown
Frontend: /deals page loads 56 deals, test deal FX-20260424-0001 at top
Frontend: No console errors on dashboard or deals pages
action_items: S3Storage path was NOT exercised end-to-end (no real S3 creds). Code structure looks correct (boto3 path-style, s3v4, content-type forwarded). Before flipping STORAGE_TYPE=s3 in prod, validate with real Huawei OBS creds. Also recommend adding a try/except around put_object in S3Storage to return a meaningful HTTPException like EmergentStorage path.

Minor: server.py uses `from services.storage import get_storage` which relies on CWD=/app/backend when uvicorn starts. Works today via supervisor but consider making it a package-relative import (`from .services.storage import get_storage`) for robustness.

Minor: S3Storage.__init__ raises KeyError (not HTTPException) if S3_BUCKET_NAME/S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID/S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY missing. Since it's a singleton init on first request, this will surface as a 500. Consider validating env on app startup when STORAGE_TYPE=s3.
critical_code_review_comments: services/storage.py: ABC interface is clean, factory singleton pattern correct
server.py L458: proof_type regex `^(client|processor)$` properly validates the query param — rejected 'invalid' with 422 as expected
server.py L471,498: Upload/delete correctly use `get_storage()` through the abstraction — no direct Emergent calls leaked in

server.py L484: GET /api/files/{path:path} is unauthenticated — acceptable for this app (proof paths contain UUIDs making enumeration hard) but worth documenting. S3 path would also be public via this endpoint, not pre-signed URLs.
S3Storage.delete_object swallows exceptions (logs warning) — parity with Emergent behavior, good choice for idempotent deletes

success_rate.frontend: 100% (smoke flow — login, dashboard, deals list, navigation)

seed_data_creation: Created deal FX-20260424-0001 (TEST_Storage Client, USD/EUR 920 @ 0.92) and uploaded/deleted PNG proofs during testing. Processor proof remains on the deal (not cleaned up).

If main agent flips STORAGE_TYPE=s3 later, rerun /app/backend/tests/test_storage_abstraction.py (the endpoints are backend-agnostic; only storage_status response would show backend='s3').
